title: Safety and Tolerability of PG110 in Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of a single intravenous dose of PG110, a monoclonal antibody that inhibits the effects of the naturally occurring substance, nerve growth factor (NGF).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Moderate to severe pain attributed to knee osteoarthritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant comorbidity
* Significant pain states other than osteoarthritis
* Concomitant medications that might affect assessments
